label: If c, distinct from x, causes x's being r, then c's having r is not received in x, from dependence
meaning: Derives the batch 1 bridge that a distinct cause does not have the perfection it causes as received in its effect. If c's having r were received in x, c would depend for its being on x (OPEN: a haver depends on its recipient); but c's causing r in x is efficiently causing it (OPEN bridge), and an efficient cause does not depend on its effect (STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-NOT-DEPENDENT-ON-EFFECT, derived in EFFICIENT-CAUSE-NOT-DEPENDENT-FROM-ASYMMETRY).
